message.reasoning_content: We need to determine offenses based on facts. Facts: Defendant Huang sold a forged "流动人口婚育证明" (a document) to Li for 20 RMB. This is a forged document used to impersonate official document. Offense: 伪造国家机关证件罪? Actually forging official documents is "伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪". The document is a population marriage and birth certificate, likely a government-issued certificate. So the offense is 伪造国家机关证件. Also selling forged documents is "买卖伪造的国家机关证件罪". Under Chinese criminal law, there are separate offenses: forging state documents, and selling forged state documents. The fact: He forged the document and sold it.
